test_title: PYST 54: SSC MTS 2024 - Numerical and Mathematical Ability (Held On: 11 Nov, 2024 - Shift 1)
subject: maths
question: A, B and C start running around a circular track and complete one round in 16, 20 and 28 seconds, respectively. In how much time will they meet again at the starting point?
solution:
**Given:**

Time taken by A to complete one round = 16 seconds

Time taken by B to complete one round = 20 seconds

Time taken by C to complete one round = 28 seconds

**Formula Used:**

To find the time when A, B, and C meet again at the starting point, calculate the LCM (Least Common Multiple) of their times.

**Calculation:**

Find the LCM of 16, 20, and 28:

Prime factorization:

16 = 2⁴

20 = 2² × 5

28 = 2² × 7

LCM = Highest powers of all prime factors

LCM = 2⁴ × 5 × 7

⇒ LCM = 16 × 5 × 7

⇒ LCM = 560 seconds

**They will meet again at the starting point after 560 seconds.**
